cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

# Recreate the local ignore rule after cloning or cleaning the build directory.
# Never ignore the source tree when configuring an in-source build.
if(NOT CMAKE_BINARY_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR AND
   NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/.gitignore")
    file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/.gitignore" "*\n")
endif()

# Generated by wch-cmake. Project-specific facts live in wch-project.cmake.
include(cmake/wch-project.cmake)
set(CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/wch-toolchain.cmake"
    CACHE FILEPATH "WCH cross-compilation toolchain")

project(${WCH_PROJECT_NAME} LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)

set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
include(cmake/wch-firmware.cmake)
wch_add_firmware(${WCH_PROJECT_NAME})

# Project-owned sources, definitions, and libraries; commit this file to Git.
# Unlike generated MRS2 settings, application.cmake survives re-imports.
# Personal presets belong in untracked CMakeUserPresets.json instead.
include(cmake/application.cmake)
